newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 580 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 580 contracts.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade's Project A overnight agricultural contracts trading volume totaled 580 contracts, according to the CBOT.
There were 54 wheat contracts, 191 corn, 302 soybean, 23 soymeal, 9 soyoil and one oats futures contracts traded, along with one soybean call option contract.

The overnight trend for corn was down 1/2 to up two cents per bushel, soybeans up 4 to 4-1/4 cents, wheat steady to up 1/4 cent, soymeal down 50 cents to up 30 cents a ton, soyoil steady, and oats down 1/2 cent per bushel.
